hints.title: Redundant Directory Component Obstacle
hints.text: Consecutive slashes and relative parent references complicate straightforward string replacement. How can tokenizing by slash allow you to add or drop directories based on each segment?

hints.title: Directory Level Splicing Invariant
hints.text: Double dots pop the most recent directory if present, single dots and empty tokens are ignored, and valid folder names append to the path.

hints.title: Segment Tokenization Procedure
hints.text: Split path by '/'. Iterate through tokens: if token is empty or '.', do nothing. If '..', pop the last directory if any exist. Otherwise, append token. Join remaining components with '/' prefixed by '/'.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.notes: Tokenizes path string and builds canonical hierarchy in linear time.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Global regex string replacement struggles with edge cases like '/.../' or chained '/../../'.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Segment tokenization consumes O(N) auxiliary space to correctly resolve directory rollbacks in O(N) time.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Proper handling of multiple consecutive slashes, parent jumps at the root directory, and periods as valid file names.
